necessary_findings.problem: Cold controller import transitively imports formal_local, which unconditionally sets HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 before huggingface_hub.constants is initialized. The legacy child imports the same controller again, so a cold uncached anonymous A manifest request fails before any network transfer. Setting only environment HF_HUB_OFFLINE=0 later cannot clear the already cached Hub constant.
necessary_findings.independent_reproduction: Two genuinely fresh processes, each with a new empty HF cache and with socket/DNS plus model forward forbidden, reproduce environment=1 and Hub constant=true after controller import, even when initially started with HF_HUB_OFFLINE=0. A subsequent environment-only override leaves the Hub constant=true. The actual fixed manifest hf_hub_download produces LocalEntryNotFoundError -> OfflineModeIsEnabled with zero network and zero model-forward calls.
necessary_findings.required_change: Isolate the online-only fixed legacy download/setup phase from imports that force training/final offline mode. Use a fresh credential-stripped bounded child, initialize Hub online policy before its first Hub import, and retain anonymous pinned repo/revision/manifest SHA/size and safe extraction checks. Keep all existing25/57 frozen sources and final opening unchanged; add any new helper to the exact source closure and a new audit-v2. Add a cold fresh-process empty-cache proof that exercises the real Hub request policy before a mocked HTTP boundary, not a replacement hf_hub_download function.
necessary_findings.previous_test_gap: The previous cached/mock positive replaced hf_hub_download itself or primed the Hub import, so it tested bytes/decoders/loaders but could not expose the cold import offline policy. Earlier sealed reports are retained without alteration.

No measurement loop is reachable when reserve step fails.
